summary: Reviewed 49 units (293-341) from the Sanskrit. Issues: 11 error, 46 minor. Units ok: 317, 322, 331, 332, 333, 336. Errors: 296 (Hindi invents शक्तियाँ and English makes vīḍavaḥ a second subject), 303 (Hindi names Uṣā and adds देवी), 307 (verb 'call' supplied although ā ... yācan governs tvā; jyā dropped not marked [unclear]), 309 (abhi sataḥ untranslated, 'wealth' supplied, kanīyasaḥ case), 315 (vaḥ most likely vi-√vṛ 'you opened', not pronoun), 316 ('which ...' placeholder, '(Soma)'), 321 (surucaḥ translated twice), 323 (text_flag claims an Ṛgveda variant adhatta that looks invented), 327 (supplied words in parentheses, aryaḥ dropped in English only), 330 (īvataḥ gram vs translation), 341 (doubled unmarked clause). Recurring minor: Hindi हरे for hari (293,301,308,313,334), worshipper for dāśvas (300,306), 'Soma' added to andhas (297,313), vipra/ṛṣi mix (337), vāja/पुरस्कार (316,329,337), iṣ as अन्न (295,338), -mat/-tama splits (296,301,306), silent corrections without text_flags (308,312,340). Manual decisions: 293 'from your abode'; 298 aṃśu share vs Soma-stalk; 300 role of second na; 305 ādunyathā person; 309 rewrite; 310 dadhiṣe vs dadhiṣeya in words; 313 ny asmin vs anyasmin; 314 mamadaḥ/dadaḥ gram; 315 vaḥ/second line and adardar; 323 adhadrāḥ flag; 330 īvataḥ clause. No regrouping suggested. Glossary additions suggested: parjanya = Parjanya (पर्जन्य); śravas = fame (कीर्ति), distinct from yaśas = glory; brahman (n., 'brahmāṇi') = sacred word (पवित्र वचन); iḍā = Iḍā/refreshment (one choice); aṃśu = Soma-stalk (सोम का डण्ठल); sagara = ocean (समुद्र); dānava = Dānavas (दानव), no 'sons of Danu'. Draft layers remain an unreviewed AI draft until a person reads them.
